learnerStatement: Simulated learner. This review finds problems; it is not evidence that anyone learned.
learnerBoundary: Everyday numeracy, simple charts, comparison of numbers and familiar household objects; no domain-specific theory assumed.

observations.prediction: Selected harm four and locked it in.
observations.exploration: Harm0.25 showed two cases daily for0.8 days, R0 1.6. Harm one showed four for0.5, R0 two. Harm four showed eight for0.2, R0 1.6. Home harm0.1 gave R0 1.1; End harm eight gave R0 1.3. Restored harm one.
observations.reveal: Corrected to harm one, listed all five actually visited points, supplied daily spread four times square root harm and duration one divided by one plus harm. Explicitly said square-root link chosen, real germs vary and theory debated.
observations.visual: Actual dark 1257 by 936 screenshots inspected. Plot accumulated visited points on labeled logarithmic harm axis and formed rise-then-fall profile. Product explanation, current values and model caveat legible.
observations.previewIsolation: Preview banner said history and analytics are not saved.
observations.blinding: No source, builder notes or other reviews inspected.

prediction.reason: Tradeoff direction is meaningful but exact optimum underdetermined before functions are supplied.
prediction.evidence: Only low-harm example and qualitative faster/shorter premise given initially.

interaction.reason: Presets and endpoints build a genuine nonmonotonic contrast.
interaction.evidence: R0 1.6,2.0,1.6 across three presets; lower at both range ends.

payoff.reason: Reveal connects observed optimum to rate-duration product and chosen functions.
payoff.evidence: Square-root spread and reciprocal duration explained.

clarity.reason: Toy label, R0 definition and selected-function caveat bound interpretation.
clarity.evidence: Log harm axis labeled; real germs vary statement.

transfer.reason: General tradeoff principle stated without a fresh application.

accessibility.evidence: Keyboard endpoints and text product values observed; screen reader, contrast and reduced motion unaudited.

surprise.reason: More daily transmission can reduce total spread.
surprise.evidence: High harm eight daily but R0 1.6 versus middle two.

visualExplanation.reason: Accumulated points show an interior maximum.
visualExplanation.evidence: Rise then fall across visited harm levels.

practicalValue.evidence: Chosen link and debated theory disclosed.

depth.reason: Competing nonlinear functions produce an optimum.
depth.evidence: Rate times duration with explicit formulas.

complexity.reason: Simple controls introduce epidemiological rate-duration and nonlinear function reasoning.
complexity.conceptualDemand: Distinguish daily transmission from total secondary cases and compare competing scaling functions.
complexity.prerequisiteNovelty: R0, harm-dependent removal and log-scaled axis.
complexity.notationRepresentationBurden: Square roots,reciprocals,decimal durations and logarithmic harm.

whyCool: Faster per day can lose overall when the infectious window shrinks enough.
caveat: Toy functions determine the optimum; rounded endpoint rate and duration may not multiply exactly to displayed R0. No real-germ inference is supported.
effort: Approximately 3 minutes of actual browser review.
